answer: A road is only as honest as the milestones along it, and every milestone is cut by the man who walked the road. Proof of lighthouse keeper log via nightly watch walks it that way: a log the keeper signs only after he tends a lamp he actually watched. The raven is the first milestone, set where the road begins; the plume is the last, set where it ends. A liar must carve 19 false milestones and hire 19 false walkers to swear they set them, and the comet still shows no footprints of his.
